description: Angular component for managing general settings and device connectivity settings in the Thingsboard admin UI.

classes.name: GeneralSettingsComponent
classes.description: Angular component for editing general and device connectivity settings in the admin panel.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions when the component is destroyed.

methods.name: buildGeneralServerSettingsForm
methods.description: Initializes the form for general server settings.

methods.name: buildDeviceConnectivitySettingsForm
methods.description: Initializes the form for device connectivity settings.

methods.name: buildDeviceConnectivityInfoForm
methods.description: Creates a form group for individual device connectivity info.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves general settings to the server.

methods.name: saveDeviceConnectivitySettings
methods.description: Saves device connectivity settings to the server.

methods.name: discardGeneralSettings
methods.description: Resets general settings form to last saved state.

methods.name: discardDeviceConnectivitySettings
methods.description: Resets device connectivity form to last saved state.

methods.name: processGeneralSettings
methods.description: Updates form with fetched general settings.

methods.name: processDeviceConnectivitySettings
methods.description: Updates form with fetched device connectivity settings.

methods.name: confirmForm
methods.description: Returns the form that has unsaved changes for confirmation.
